name: Schema - tool merge record and properties

parameters.content:
# Merge record and properties
Takes any input and adds the individual properties to the record property

## Example: 
```
{ 
    "record": {
        "@context": "https://schema.org/",
        "@type": "Thing",
        "@id": "thing1",
        "name": "thing1"
    },
    "url": "https://www.test.com",
    "result.url": "https://www.result.com"
}
```
Into
```
{
    "@context": "https://schema.org/",
    "@type": "Thing",
    "@id": "thing1",
    "name": "thing1",
    "url": "https://www.test.com",
    "result": {
        "url": "https://www.result.com"
    }
}
```
